assertionCoverage.name: LITE-07-104: real test subprocess -> collector -> HTTP queue/review -> Entry/source content
assertionCoverage.clause: The Collector's real test observation creates one durable ArtifactCompletion record.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: After recording the child process observations through the production Collector, the test queries the mounted HTTP completion route and directly asserts the durable completion exists.

assertionCoverage.clause: The completed Artifact's Candidate appears in the review-required queue.
